supporting_observations.claim: WS-LMARTINS-01 made a series of HTTP connections to the internal explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080. The recorded connections from 13:35:56 through 14:05:48 are roughly five minutes apart.

The cadence is consistent with the inventory description of the PixelForge updater checking for updates about every five minutes, but the available records do not identify PixelForge as the process responsible.
The supplied proxy connection records identify the internal proxy as the destination, but do not show the external hostname, URL, or application process associated with these connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided network records show connections to the explicit proxy, not the external destination or HTTPS request details.
The provided records do not link the periodic proxy connections to a process, executable path, or user-agent.
The records cover selected events in the review window; absence of other event types in the supplied data does not establish that they did not occur.
claims_not_established: Whether the proxy connections were to updates.pixelforge-suite.com or another destination.
Whether the traffic was benign update checking or malicious activity using a similar cadence.
Whether the proxy returned content or responses that were executed or otherwise used on the workstation.

Endpoint telemetry correlating the listed connections with the initiating process, including image path, command line, signer, and file hash.
PixelForge updater logs and installation details for WS-LMARTINS-01 during the review window.
